The Associate Director, HR Transformation & Employee Experience, will lead the redesign and modernization of HR processes, operating models, and employee journeys to create a simpler, more agile, scalable, and AI-enabled HR function.The role will drive enterprise-wide HR transformation by reimagining workflows through automation, GenAI, and agentic AI capabilities, ensuring seamless employee experiences while improving operational effectiveness, productivity, governance, and service excellence. title: Principal Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Anticipate industry shifts (e.g.,AGI,regulation,ethical AI,multi-modal systems) and prepare the org to adapt.

Qualifications . PhD (preferred) or Master s with 12 15+ years of experience in AI / ML research and applied product delivery.

descriptionFromApi:
Position Summary

As a Principal Data Scientist, you will serve as the visionary and enterprise-wide AI leader, responsible for shaping the long-term AI strategy and ensuring the organization remains at the forefront of innovation. You will set the research agenda, influence executive decision-making, and represent the company’s AI capabilities externally to customers, partners, and the industry. While Senior Staff drives strategy within the org, Principal defines the horizon, aligning business direction with scientific breakthroughs and ensuring that AI investments yield transformative impact.


Key Responsibilities

 AI Vision & Thought Leadership

  • Define and champion the long-term AI vision of the company.
  • Anticipate industry shifts (e.g., AGI, regulation, ethical AI, multi-modal systems) and prepare the org to adapt.
  • Shape internal and external conversations on responsible, scalable, and impactful AI.

Strategic Business Alignment

  • Partner with executive leadership (CTO, CPO, CEO) to connect AI strategy with business growth, market positioning, and customer needs.
  • Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to transform product lines, workflows, or new revenue streams.
  • Make investment recommendations (build vs. buy vs. partner) for long-term advantage.

Scientific & Technical Leadership

  • Push boundaries by sponsoring cutting-edge research (e.g., foundation models, domain-specific GenAI, neuro-symbolic AI).
  • Drive IP creation through patents, publications, and open-source leadership.
  • Define enterprise-wide AI standards, architectures, and ethical frameworks.
  • Provide final guidance on complex architectural trade-offs with company-wide implications.

Cross-Org & Industry Influence

  • Mentor Senior Staff and Staff Data Scientists, creating a pipeline of future leaders.
  • Serve as the external face of AI at conferences, research consortiums, and client CxO discussions.
  • Build strategic partnerships with academia, research labs, and industry consortia to bring new innovations in.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Establish AI governance policies for fairness, compliance, security, and explainability.
  • Influence external regulatory and standards bodies to shape the future of responsible AI.
  • Ensure AI adoption scales safely, reliably, and with business continuity.

Qualifications
  • PhD (preferred) or Master’s with 12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML research and applied product delivery.
  • Recognized leader with industry publications, patents, or external visibility.
  • Proven record of shaping enterprise-wide AI strategy and delivering lasting business impact.

Preferred Attributes
  • Visionary mindset: sees beyond current problems to the future of the field.
  • Influential communicator who can bridge executives, researchers, and engineers.
  • Strong presence in the AI community (thought leadership, keynote talks, collaborations).
  • Capable of balancing research innovation with business pragmatism.

descriptionFromApi:
What's the Role All About? 

 

The Senior Software Engineer is a customer-facing, billable role responsible for implementing, configuring, and delivering AI-driven and Conversational AI solutions across the NICE CXone ecosystem.  As a hands-on technical contributor, you will build integrations, configure conversational AI platforms, and ensure high-quality execution of project deliverables.  

 

How Will You Make an Impact? 

  • Technical Implementation and Configuration:  
    • Configure, customize, and deploy Conversational AI solutions aligned to defined business and technical requirements.
    • Build and maintain integrations using APIs, modern web technologies, and authentication standards.
    • Implement, enhance, and optimize bot behaviors using conversational design and prompt engineering best practices.
    • Develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and production-ready solution components.
    • Support testing, validation, and go-live activities to ensure solutions are functioning as expected across customer environments. 
  • Technical Problem Solving & Quality:  
    • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across SaaS applications, integrations, environments, and data flows.
    • Adapt, extend, or refactor existing integrations and solution components to meet evolving customer needs.
    • Ensure implementations meet quality, performance, security, and usability standards.
    • Produce documentation including specifications, test cases, and deployment materials. 
  • Collaboration with Implementation Teams:  
    • Partner closely with Implementation Engineers, Consultants and Project Managers who lead discovery, requirements definition, and solution design.
    • Participate in customer workshops to clarify technical details, validate feasibility, and provide subjectmatter input.
    • Maintain clear and consistent communication across crossfunctional delivery teams.

 

Have You Got What It Takes? 

  • Bachelor’s degree in technical or business field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering) or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience, with 1+ years in digital channels or AI/Bot software applications preferred.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Strong proficiency in JavaScript; Python familiarity is a plus.
    • Solid understanding of:
      • REST API integration patterns
      • Modern authentication (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML)
      • Browser and web security (CORS, X Frame Options)
      • HTML/CSS and front-end fundamentals
    • Ability to interpret API documentation, implement PoCs, and troubleshoot integrations.
    • Strong understanding of conversational UX, AI driven interfaces, and prompt engineering techniques.
  • Communication and Collaboration:
    • Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
    • Comfortable engaging with customers to explain technical concepts and implementation decisions.
    • Effective collaborator during design discussions, code reviews, technical troubleshooting, and delivery execution.
  • Authored detailed design documents, functional requirements documents, test use cases, and deployment guides to support implementation and delivery.
  • Willingness to work in US shift (5 PM – 2 AM IST).

 

You Will Have an Advantage If You Also Have: 

  • Experience designing and deploying enterprise-grade conversational flows and AI orchestration. 
  • Experience with NiCE CXone products or other cloud-based contact center platforms. 
  • Experience working with enterprise conversational AI platforms (e.g., NICE CXone, Kore.ai, Amelia, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and debugging tools for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data integration patterns.

title: Manager - Knowledge Management ((Corporate Law Firm))
jobDescription:
Candidates should have experience in Legal Industry, in Knowledge Management / Intellectual Property Management


Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Strong understanding of legal Knowledge Management principles and best practices.

  • Expertise in precedent management, content governance, taxonomy development, and legal knowledge organization.
  • Strong understanding of legal research methodologies and legal information resources.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise KM platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, legal technology solutions, and automation tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project and change management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

We are looking for passionate and skilled Software Developers to join our Core AI Services team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across AVEVAs product portfolio and partner ecosystem.
You will part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset - rapid prototyping and continuous improvement with agility of a start-up.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.
  • Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.
  • Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and architectural discussions to ensure engineering excellence.
  • Mentor junior developers, encourage continuous learning, and contribute to a culture of innovation.
  • Work with multiple teams to create AI solutions, which include AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development.
AI & Cloud Expertise
  • Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding of trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.
  • Experience with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
  • Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning)
  • Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act), and commitment to responsible AI development.
  • Fluent in developing code using AI Tools such as GitHub Copilot. Must be able to use prompt engineering to carry out multiple development tasks.
  • Familiar with AI orchestration, including tools like AI Foundry and/or Semantic Kernel, MAF.
  • Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs is a plus.

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years working directly on AI/ML systems or platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and associated PaaS services (e.g., Azure Functions, AKS, API Management).

jobDescription:
About The Role


  • Job Title:Senior Manager Data AI


  • Location:Mumbai, Gurgaon, Bangalore


  • Department:AI Data in Growth Networks


  • Experience:8-10 years


  • Role Overview
    We are seeking a seasoned

    Senior Manager Data AI to lead complex, high-impact client engagements and deliver data-driven transformation programs. This individual will work closely with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and drive business value through innovative application of data engineering, analytics, and AI technologies.
    This is a strategic, client-facing leadership role requiring strong technical understanding, delivery excellence, stakeholder management, and business consulting experience.


  • Key Responsibilities


  • Client Engagement Leadership
  • Act as the primary engagement leader for Data AI projects across multiple clients
  • Build and maintain trusted executive-level client relationships
  • Understand business challenges and translate them into data-driven solutions
  • Lead pre-sales discussions, solution design, scoping and proposal creation


  • Project Delivery Execution
  • Oversee end-to-end delivery of complex Data, Analytics AI programmes
  • Manage cross-functional data teams (data engineers, data scientists, analysts, architects)
  • Ensure delivery quality, scope adherence, timelines, and budget
  • Establish data governance, delivery frameworks, and operational excellence practices


  • Technical Strategic Leadership
  • Develop data modernization, cloud analytics, MLOps and AI adoption strategies
  • Guide team on data engineering, analytics, AI, ML, and Generative AI best practices
  • Review architectures, models, pipelines and solutions for quality and scalability
  • Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI and GenAI capabilities


  • People Development
  • Mentor and coach project managers and technical teams
  • Lead talent development, workforce planning, and capability building
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture


  • Business Development
  • Identify new opportunities within existing accounts
  • Support organization-wide Data AI GTM initiatives
  • Represent the company in thought leadership, events, and client workshops



    • Qualification


  • Required
    Qualifications Skills


  • Education
  • Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related discipline will be preferred
  • MBA preferred but not mandatory


  • Professional Skills
  • Strong client leadership, consulting, and executive stakeholder management
  • Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar data initiatives
  • Excellent communication, facilitation presentation skills
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking abilities


  • Key Traits Competencies
  • Strategic thinker with execution excellence mindset
  • Customer-obsessed with strong business acumen
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrix environment
  • High adaptability and continuous-learning mindset
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and proactive

This person will lead the company through a rigorous GAAP close, consolidation, revenue recognition, reporting, audit, payroll partnership, finance administration, and accounting systems environment.   • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, driving a disciplined, accurate, and increasingly efficient GAAP close process
  • Lead global consolidation across multiple legal entities, currencies, and jurisdictions, including intercompany accounting and eliminations
  • Own advanced and technical accounting matters, including revenue recognition, complex transactions, accounting policy, and GAAP interpretation

  • Lead the evolution of the company s accounting systems, integrations, and financial data architecture, reducing manual processes and improving control and visibility
  • Partner closely with People Operations on global payroll, ensuring accurate accounting, reconciliations, controls, and coordination across payroll providers and entities
  • Oversee core finance administration, including banking, treasury administration, entity support, expense and vendor processes, accounting documentation, and related operational workflows

  • Proactively identify financial, accounting, systems, and process risks and resolve issues before they create downstream problems

jobDescription:
About the Role

Lifesight is seeking a Lead Marketing Scientist to head a team of marketing scientists in developing advanced econometric and statistical models that solve complex marketing measurement problems. The role is anchored in scientific rigor and demands strong foundations in econometrics, causal inference, and statistical learning.

You will focus on building robust, interpretable, and scalable models - particularly in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) - while ensuring causal validity and statistical soundness. Beyond hands-on modeling, you will mentor a team of data scientists and shape the evolution of measurement methodologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Econometric Modeling MMM Development
  • Lead the design and implementation of Marketing Mix Models (MMM), formulating business problems as rigorous quantitative and statistical models.
  • Build models using regression-based approaches (linear and non-linear), time series methods for trend, seasonality, and forecasting, and Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks.
  • Incorporate core marketing science constructs, including adstock and lag effects, saturation and diminishing returns, and external drivers and control variables.
  • Ensure statistical robustness through proper model specification, parameter stability and interpretability, and sensitivity analysis.

Causal Inference Measurement Design
  • Apply causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and experimental and quasi-experimental designs.
  • Design and evaluate incrementality frameworks, including geo experiments and holdout testing.
  • Address endogeneity, confounding, and bias in observational datasets to ensure causal validity of model outputs.

Statistical Validation Diagnostics
  • Perform rigorous model validation, including residual analysis and diagnostics, multicollinearity checks, and out-of-sample and cross-validation.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics and ensure alignment with business outcomes.

Analytical Frameworks Model Integration
  • Develop integrated measurement frameworks that combine MMM, attribution, and experimentation.
  • Apply machine learning techniques where they enhance model performance without compromising interpretability.
  • Build scalable, reusable modeling approaches that strengthen the organization s measurement methodology.

Scientific Communication
  • Translate complex statistical outputs into structured, interpretable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Clearly articulate model assumptions, limitations, and implications, and support decision-making with evidence-based recommendations.

Team Leadership Capability Building
  • Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, establishing best practices in statistical modeling, code quality, and reproducibility.
  • Build team capability in advanced topics such as Bayesian modeling, causal inference, and experimental design.

Research, Delivery Collaboration
  • Stay current with advancements in econometrics, marketing science, causal inference, and statistical learning, and implement improved methodologies that enhance modeling accuracy and reliability.
  • Manage multiple analytical projects to defined timelines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure modeling outputs align with business needs.

Required Skills Experience

About Advantage HQ
Advantage HQ is building the next generation of creator-led growth infrastructure for consumer brands.
We combine creative strategy, creator partnerships, performance content, whitelisting, affiliate distribution, paid media, and proprietary technology into one integrated growth system.
Our team manages more than $850 million in annual media spend and works with a network of more than 400,000 creators across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Through Meteoric AI, our proprietary intelligence platform, we use data and AI to improve decision-making across creative production, creator selection, customer acquisition, campaign performance, and brand growth.
We work with ambitious consumer brands across health, wellness, beauty, nutrition, personal care, and lifestyle.
The Opportunity
At our scale, operational problems rarely exist within one team.
A process that works for five people may fail at fifty. A training gap in one team can become a performance issue across dozens of accounts. Capacity decisions made too late can affect client delivery.
The Senior Media Operations Manager will be responsible for solving these problems at a broader organizational level.
You will lead multiple media teams and managers while building the systems, standards, and processes that allow Advantage HQs Media Buying organization to scale.
What Youll Own Scale the Media Operations system
You will identify what is preventing the media organization from operating more efficiently and build systems to address those constraints.
This includes processes for account management, campaign execution, quality control, reporting, escalation, training, and performance management.
Lead multiple teams and managers
You will manage multiple teams through their respective leaders and establish clear expectations for performance, quality, and leadership.
You will develop Managers and Team Leads rather than becoming the escalation point for every operational issue.
Build performance and quality frameworks
You will define the metrics and operating mechanisms used to understand whether teams are performing effectively.
You will identify trends across accounts and teams and turn those insights into organizational improvements.
Own capacity planning
You will work with leadership to understand client growth, team capacity, hiring requirements, and resource allocation.
You will help the organization anticipate capacity constraints rather than reacting after teams become overloaded.
Drive continuous improvement
You will identify opportunities to use technology, AI, automation, and better processes to improve productivity and reduce unnecessary operational work.
You will establish a culture where teams continuously improve how they operate.
Who You Are
You are a systems thinker who understands paid media deeply and knows how to operate through other leaders.
You are comfortable looking across multiple teams and identifying patterns that individual managers may not see.
You are highly analytical but practical. You care about metrics, but you also understand that systems only work when people actually use them.
You enjoy building structure in environments that are still evolving and are comfortable making decisions without having every answer available.
Experience We Value
  • 8+ years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, growth, or a related field
  • Extensive e-commerce experience
  • 3+ years managing media teams, managers, or multiple team leads
  • Experience building scalable operating systems and processes
  • Experience with capacity planning, workforce planning, and resource allocation
  • Strong understanding of media performance and client delivery
  • Experience with automation, AI, analytics, or operational technology is valuable
  • Strong leadership, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Experience in a high-growth agency, performance marketing, or similar environment
Why Join Advantage HQ
You will have the opportunity to help design how a large-scale media organization actually operates.
Your work will influence how teams are structured, how managers lead, how performance is measured, how resources are allocated, and how Advantage HQ scales its media capabilities without sacrificing quality.
Compensation Location
  • $60,000 - $120,000 USD total annual compensation, including base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
  • Fully remote. We have built the infrastructure for high-performance distributed teams and trust our people to do their best work from wherever they work best.
  • We are open to candidates globally.
  • We care far more about ownership, judgment, and execution than geography.
If youre excited by building scalable systems, developing leaders, improving operational performance, and solving complex challenges across multiple teams, wed love to hear from you.

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries - from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrots comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Companys Most Innovative Companies and CNBCs 100 Barrier Breaking Startups. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets - including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review - as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrots data infrastructure.

You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions.

Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed.

What You ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs.
  • Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL.
  • Architect and optimize data warehouse models that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting.
  • Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance across all data systems.
  • Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance, including documentation and metadata practices.
  • Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas and event models with analytics and reporting in mind.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Own team-level planning and execution, including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams.
  • Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap with measurable outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers.
  • Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions, vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12-18 months, you will have:

  • Elevated the maturity and consistency of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability.
  • Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business.
  • Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization.
  • Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts.
  • Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrots long-term data architecture strategy.




About You

You likely have:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years leading and managing data or software engineers.
  • 5+ years of advanced SQL and 5+ years of Python development experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing.
  • Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines in production.
  • Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow).
  • Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles, plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards while remaining capable of direct technical execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols.

Nice to Have

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Direct experience with Carrots current tech stack: Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS.
  • Experience with enterprise BI platforms and enabling self-service analytics.
  • Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems.
  • Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment, ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs.
  • Healthcare industry experience, including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR).

Why This Role Matters

The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrots data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability.

The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the companys long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot.



Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen - 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview - 30-45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews - 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation - 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up - 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

  • Drive consistency and improvements in software quality processes, tools, templates, and practices across product teams.

  • Support complaint investigations, CAPA activities, audit observations, software nonconformances, and corrective action initiatives.
  • Provide quality guidance for cloud-enabled, cybersecurity-related, AI-enabled, and data-driven software solutions, as applicable.
  • Assess emerging technologies, development methodologies, and industry trends to identify quality and compliance improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and promote best practices, guidance materials, and reusable quality frameworks that improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Mentor and coach Software Quality Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders on software quality processes, regulatory expectations, and risk-based decision making.
  • Act as a trusted advisor within the Software Quality organization, helping shape future quality capabilities, operating practices, and organizational best practices.

Sr Software Engineer (Mainframe / COBOL)

Powering the worlds payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem globally, and you power ACI. Youll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers at every level are empowered to make a meaningful impact while working on solutions that process billions of transactions worldwide.

As a Sr Software Engineer in Bangalore, you will join a diverse and passionate engineering team responsible for delivering highly reliable card and merchant payment solutions that serve financial institutions across the globe.

Job Summary

ACI Worldwide is seeking an experienced Sr Software Engineer with strong Mainframe and COBOL development expertise to join our Card & Merchant Management (CMM) engineering team. This role focuses on designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting mission-critical payment processing applications used by leading financial institutions worldwide.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in COBOL-based development, strong analytical problem-solving skills, experience in high-volume transaction processing environments, and a passion for adopting AI-powered engineering practices to improve quality, productivity, and operational excellence.

A Typical Day at ACI

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions supporting ACIs card payment platforms.
  • Develop and support applications utilizing COBOL, JCL, DB2, and VSAM on IBM Mainframe environments.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and code reviews to ensure engineering excellence.
  • Develop and execute automated unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure product quality.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer-reported defects and production incidents.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Engineering teams.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, and engineering specifications.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, estimation, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on performance, resiliency, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to enhance software development productivity and quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies including the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Needed to Succeed

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 8+ years of software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in COBOL, JCL, and DB2 development.
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe technologies.
  • Experience developing and supporting high-volume transaction processing systems.
  • Experience using AI-powered development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, and problem-solving.
  • Ability to effectively apply AI solutions to software development, automated testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational workflows.
  • Experience with source code management tools such as Git.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working within Agile software development methodologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within global cross-functional teams.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Experience within the payments industry supporting Visa, Mastercard, Discover, AMEX, JCB, or other card payment networks.
  • Knowledge of card issuing, acquiring, authorization, clearing, settlement, or interchange processing.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux administration and shell scripting.
  • Java development experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of VSAM.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability transaction processing environments.
  • Experience driving performance engineering, resiliency, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Exposure to cloud-hosted payment platforms and modernization of legacy enterprise applications.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.

Core Capabilities

We seek colleagues who embody ACIs core capabilities and contribute to our innovative engineering culture:

  • Ensure Accountability: Hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Drives Results: Consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances.
  • Customer Focus: Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Cultivate Innovation: Create new and better ways for the organization to succeed.
  • Collaborates: Build partnerships and work effectively across teams and geographies.
  • Courage: Step up to address difficult issues and say what needs to be said.

AI Readiness

At ACI, AI is becoming an integral part of our engineering culture. Successful candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and practical application of AI technologies in software engineering. Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

  • How they currently use AI tools in their development workflow.
  • Examples of AI-assisted coding, testing, automation, or problem-solving.
  • Their approach to responsible and effective AI adoption.
  • Opportunities they see for leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.

Why Join ACI

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Description

Invent the future with us.

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we d love to have you apply!
About the role:
As a vital member of the layout team, you will be responsible for delivering precise layouts that comply with LVS, DRC, ERC, EM, and IR standards. Your role will require close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth full-chip integration and high-quality design execution. You should be self-motivated, capable of independently resolving critical issues, managing schedules, and leading others to successfully complete their tasks. Additionally, you will mentor junior team members to enhance their skills and support their professional growth.
What you ll achieve:
  • Collaborate with the Place & Route (P&R) team to resolve full-chip integration issues.
  • Develop and improve methodologies to simplify custom macro integration into the P&R flow.
  • Floorplan and build out cells, blocks, and macros efficiently.
  • Understand, create, and debug LEF files to support design processes.
  • Design complex layouts for both analog and digital circuits using deep submicron technologies.
  • Analyze and interpret LVS, DRC, ERC, EM, and IR results to identify and resolve issues.
  • Identify schematic or layout problems and work closely with engineering teams to address them.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects across different technologies simultaneously.
  • Learn and effectively utilize Ampere s in-house design tools.
  • Coordinate with circuit engineers located in different regions and time zones.
  • Support and assist during tapeout phases to ensure successful project completion.
  • Contribute ideas as an integral part of a small, collaborative team.
  • Coach and train junior engineers to foster skill development within the team.
About you:
  • Bachelors degree with 8 years or Master s degree with 6 years of experience in custom layout design
  • Current hands-on experience with 3nm technology is essential
  • Exposure and experience in laying out custom digital components such as SRAM, register files, and standard cells
  • High proficiency in designing custom analog blocks including amplifiers, PLL, LDO, and resistor ladders
  • Experience with full-chip integration of custom IP alongside P&R teams
  • Solid knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM), hierarchical layout techniques, device matching, and low-parasitic layout practices
  • Good understanding of Electromigration (EM) and IR drop analysis
  • Proficient with Cadence XL/GXL/EXL and Mentor Graphics Calibre tools
  • Familiarity with Cadence Innovus is a plus
  • Experience with Totem tools for EM/IR analysis is advantageous
  • Programming skills are a plus but not required
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple locations and time zones
What we ll offer:

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
Benefits highlights include:
  • Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
  • Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
  • Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.
And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
